description: Level shifter, 3V3 SPI up to 5V for the DAC
notes: SAME part as the instrument LED shifter. Covers SCLK MOSI CS with a spare gate, each from U-RX-MOD's second inverter. *** VCC IS DAC_AVDD, THE DAC'S OWN RAIL (U-REG-DAC), NOT LOGIC_5V. *** Its outputs are the DAC8568's SYNC, SCLK and DIN, whose absolute maximum is AVDD + 0.3V [ds DAC8568CIPW.pdf p.2]; LOGIC_5V arrives first and leaves last, so on it these pins would sit volts over AVDD for milliseconds at every power-up and power-down - do not move it back (digital-and-supervision/sim, rails-and-sync and its what-if). Its inputs come from U-RX-MOD on LOGIC_5V and sit above its VCC while DAC_AVDD is low, which the no-clamp property below makes legal. *** NO INPUT CLAMP TO VCC, *** confirmed three independent ways in SCLS264O: abs-max lists 'Input clamp current, IIK (VI < 0): -20mA', NEGATIVE ONLY, against an output clamp specified BOTH ways; abs-max input voltage is -0.5 to 7V stated WITHOUT reference to VCC where the output is -0.5 to VCC+0.5; and input leakage is specified as +/-1uA max AT VI = 5.5V WITH VCC = 0V, which TI could not guarantee if a VCC clamp existed. THAT IS WHAT MAKES BACK-DRIVING AN UNPOWERED MODULE SAFE. Its inputs are driven by U-RX-MOD, the Schmitt stage, not by the cable: the thresholds the link is analysed against are U-RX-MOD's. Drive +/-8mA; input transition rate must be <= 20ns/V; TIE EVERY UNUSED INPUT TO VCC OR GND. *** OE IS TIED ENABLED AND MUST STAY THAT WAY. *** The presence-gated OE is deleted along with its comparator: the threshold sat inside the breath signal's own range, it locked out every standalone-module milestone, and it failed toward 'present'. What it was protecting against - floating CMOS at the DAC while the instrument is off - is what R-SPI-PULL's six resistors are for, and running the buffer unconditionally is what every surveyed Eurorack module does

description: SPI receiver: hex Schmitt-trigger inverter, SCLK MOSI CS each through two gates, ahead of U-LVL-MOD
notes: THE SPI LINK'S RECEIVER (owner, 2026-09-30: 'add buffer' - with hysteresis, at the receiving end). The cable's SCLK/MOSI pair couples each SCLK edge into MOSI for about one round trip, far enough to cross a plain TTL input's thresholds (spi-pair-crosstalk); behind R-RX-MOD and C-RX-MOD this input does not see it (interfaces/spi-link/sim). TTL-COMPATIBLE: VT+ 0.9-2.1V, VT- 0.5-1.7V over VCC 4.5-5.5V, HYSTERESIS 0.4V MIN [ds SN74AHCT14.pdf p.5]. INVERTING: each signal uses two gates, so all six are used and none needs a tie. *** NO INPUT CLAMP TO VCC, *** like U-LVL-MOD: I_IK is specified for VI < 0 only [p.4] and I_I is +/-1uA at VCC = 0V [p.5], so a powered instrument back-driving an unpowered module is still safe - do not substitute a 74HCT14, whose inputs clamp to VCC. From LOGIC_5V, decoupled by C-DEC-RX (a C-DECOUPLE). tpd 1-9ns [p.6]. TI SN74AHCT14DR, LCSC C141316

description: Series half of the RC ahead of each U-RX-MOD input
notes: THREE: R-RX-SCLK, R-RX-MOSI, R-RX-CS, from the cable node (where the R-SPI-PULL and R-CS-PULL-MOD pulls stay) to U-RX-MOD's first gate. With C-RX-MOD, 47ns: the cable's crosstalk and reflections last about one round trip and reach the Schmitt input far inside its hysteresis (interfaces/spi-link/sim). 1k against the line's 50-280 ohm modes is near-open, so it leaves the line's termination as it was. Against a 10k pull-down the settled high at the input is 3.3 x 10k / (10k + 1.1k) = 2.97V, above VT+ max 2.1V [calc]. UNI-ROYAL 0805W8F1001T5E, LCSC C17513

description: Shunt half of the RC ahead of each U-RX-MOD input
notes: THREE: C-RX-SCLK, C-RX-MOSI, C-RX-CS, U-RX-MOD's input pin to DIG_GND, at the pin. C0G so the time constant does not move with bias or temperature; +/-5% is in the sim's corners. Slows each edge by 65-90ns to the input's highest threshold (interfaces/spi-link/sim), against the DAC's 250ns half-period at 2MHz. Samsung CL21C470JBANNNC, LCSC C14857
